question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing left winger, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing right back, and Eve is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Claire trade positions. Finally, Bob and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) left winger
(C) right midfielder
(D) right back
(E) goalkeeper
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve.
Initial: left midfielder | left winger | right midfielder | right back | goalkeeper
1. Bob–Eve: left midfielder | goalkeeper | right midfielder | right back | left winger
2. Claire–Alice: right midfielder | goalkeeper | left midfielder | right back | left winger
3. Claire–Dave: right midfielder | goalkeeper | right back | left midfielder | left winger
4. Eve–Claire: right midfielder | goalkeeper | left winger | left midfielder | right back
5. Bob–Eve: right midfielder | right back | left winger | left midfielder | goalkeeper
Claire's final position is left winger, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
